name: miro
description: Miro's ship after the reference sheet: a cozy faceted body, a canopy laid on its back, four hexagonal nacelles at the corners of an X, each carrying a hinged delta wing; lift jets under the belly, neon.

inputs.name: lower_offset
inputs.description: the lower nacelles (and their wings) set lower and further aft

inputs.name: upper_offset
inputs.description: the upper nacelles (and their wings) set higher and further aft

inputs.name: nose
inputs.description: the length of the cockpit and the snout ahead of it

inputs.name: spread
inputs.description: the nacelles' distance from the axis (m)

inputs.name: span
inputs.description: the wings' span beyond their root

inputs.name: sweep
inputs.description: extra sweep of the wings (m back per m of span)

inputs.name: variety
inputs.description: how far each seed strays from the inputs (proportions and colours)
